card.title: IN HOUR OF NEED
card.flavorText: A month after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, President Roosevelt established the War Production Board. The purpose of the board was to convert peacetime industries into weapons and military factories. Another purpose was to conserve metal, petroleum, rubber, paper and plastic for the war effort, which meant strict rationing for civilians. F.ex. the US had manufactured 3 million civilian automobiles in 1941, but during the course of the war only 139 were manufactured.
